theorem ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.iIndepFun.extracted_1.{u_10, u_8, u_7, u_2, u_1} {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2}
  {Ω : Type u_7} {_mα : MeasurableSpace α} {_mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {κ : Kernel α Ω} {μ : Measure α} {β : ι → Type u_8}
  {m : (i : ι) → MeasurableSpace (β i)} {f : (i : ι) → Ω → β i} {J : Type u_10} (S : J → Finset ι)
  (h_disjoint : Set.univ.PairwiseDisjoint S) (hf_Indep : iIndepFun m f κ μ) (hf_meas : ∀ (i : ι), Measurable (f i)) :
  let F := fun j a i => f (↑i) a;
  ∀ (i : J), MeasurableSpace.comap (F i) ((fun x => pi) i) ≤ _mΩ := by
  intro j
      rw [← measurable_iff_comap_le, measurable_pi_iff]
      intro ω
      simp [F]
      exact hf_meas ω

theorem measurable_pi_iff {g : α → ∀ a, π a} : Measurable g ↔ ∀ a, Measurable fun x => g x a := by
  simp_rw [measurable_iff_comap_le, MeasurableSpace.pi, MeasurableSpace.comap_iSup,
    MeasurableSpace.comap_comp, Function.comp_def, iSup_le_iff]

theorem measurable_iff_comap_le {m₁ : MeasurableSpace α} {m₂ : MeasurableSpace β} {f : α → β} :
    Measurable f ↔ m₂.comap f ≤ m₁ :=
  comap_le_iff_le_map.symm
